S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.title: Getter Mandala
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.INITIAL.descr: For an instant, you glimpse [sine][getter_ray]countless Getter evolutions[/getter_ray][/sine] beyond the distant void. Your hand reaches toward...
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.INITIAL.optio: A Getter battleship blotting out the sun...
The fusion of countless Getter Gs...
Choose up to 3 Attack cards to enchant with [gold]Devolution[/gold].
Choose up to 3 cards to enchant with [gold]Adaptation[/gold].
A being greater than Shin Dragon...
Obtain Holy Dragon Roar enchanted with [gold]Corrupted[/gold].
A Getter as mighty as a guardian god...
Upgrade all cards in your deck whose names contain Getter.
Heal 30 HP and add an [gold]Insect-Human Virus[/gold] to your deck.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.SOLAR_BATTLES: Somewhere deep in fate, [gold][b]guidance from a future Getter[/b][/gold] reaches you. You see the endpoint of evolution.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.GETTER_G_FUSI: You feel Shin Getter drawing the power of [red]Getter One[/red], [white]Getter Two[/white], and [yellow]Getter Three[/yellow] into one.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.PRIMAL_GETTER: [getter_ray][b]Getter[/b][/getter_ray] is both the beginning and the end.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.FIRST_EVOLUTI: Getter G... Musashi never lived to see its birth.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.HOLY_DRAGON.d: [purple][sine]The aura is terrifying[/sine][/purple]. You cannot tell whether wielding the Holy Dragon's power is right.
For a moment, the Getter in your vision merges with Shin Getter. Is this... [gold][sine]Heaven?[/sine][/gold]
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.IGNORE.descri: Invaded by BUGS, you reject [getter_ray]Getter's[/getter_ray] will.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TEA_MASTER.pa: Ryoma: [red]Tea ceremony? Take my punch first![/red]
Requires more than 5 HP and Fighting Spirit or Spirit.
Pay [red]100[/red] Gold. Choose [gold]Bone Tea[/gold] or [gold]Ember Tea[/gold].

Ryoma throws a punch across the tea table without touching his cup. The Tea Master catches it with a tray. Cushions scatter, yet not one drop spills.

The recoil drives into Ryoma's chest. He steps back, laughs, and accepts the cup still glowing with dark embers.

[red]“Now that's a proper cup!”[/red]

Benkei rolls up his sleeves. The broad hands that hold Shin Getter's controls guide the water with impossible care: warming, measuring, pouring, and steeping in perfect silence.

The Tea Master drinks, then places both Bone Tea and Ember Tea before him.

[yellow]“I learned a little while looking after the children. Even a rough man shouldn't waste good tea.”[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SLIPPERY_BRID: Ryoma: [red]You think a rotten bridge can stop me?[/red]
Requires more than 5 HP and Spirit, Drive, or Super Spirit.
Hayato: [white]It will collapse. Discard exactly what we do not need.[/white]
Choose 1 card to remove. Lose no HP.
Requires a removable card and Accel or Shed Load.

Ryoma steps into the storm. Rotten boards break beneath him, but he never looks back. Splinters cut into him, and nothing is left behind.

[red]“You want me to abandon something just to cross? Don't make me laugh!”[/red]

One glance at the current, wind, and bending boards is enough for Hayato to find the only safe sequence of steps. The chosen burden falls into the torrent, and Getter 2 flashes across the remaining frame.

[white]“The bridge does not choose the price. We do.”[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SPIRIT_GRAFTE: Requires an exclusive card for Getter 1, Getter 2, and Getter 3 in the deck.

Pale roots strike at three hearts. Ryoma resists the intrusion, Hayato severs the false connections, and Benkei bears the backlash.

Three heartbeats become one. [getter_ray][sine]Green light[/sine][/getter_ray] surges back through the roots, forcing the Grafter away.

[red]“You touched[/red] [white]our souls.[/white] [yellow]Now it is your turn to adapt.”[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WOOD_CARVINGS: Triple Unity: [red]A soaring bird[/red], [white]a cunning snake[/white], [yellow]a steadfast ring[/yellow]... That's [getter_ray]Getter[/getter_ray]!
Obtain [gold]Triple Wood Carving[/gold]. At the start of combat, [gold]Transform[/gold] 1 to 3 times at random.

Ryoma sees the force to break through the sky in the bird. Hayato finds a path without a wasted step in the snake. Benkei steadies the broken ring.

Red, white, and yellow lights rise in turn, and the three carvings become one.
Hayato: [white]There are more than two choices. Here is the payment slot.[/white]
Pay [red]75[/red] Gold. Obtain a random Relic.
Requires 75 Gold and Foresight or Backup Plan.

The two buttons blink impatiently. Ryoma punches the space between them, and the machine finally falls silent.

He takes nothing and walks over the wreckage.

[red]“Don't decide my answers for me.”[/red]

Hayato traces the back of the mechanism and uncovers a coin slot beneath the grime. The buttons go dark as a side compartment releases a relic.

[white]“Two choices are merely the question it wanted you to see.”[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.AMALGAMATOR.p: Ryoma: [red]This junk? Take all of it![/red]
Remove all [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold], then remove 1 additional card.
Requires at least 1 removable card that is neither Strike nor Defend.
Benkei: [yellow]Wait. Let me sort this out.[/yellow]
Pay [red]100[/red] Gold. Remove 2 [gold]Strikes[/gold] and 2 [gold]Defends[/gold]. Obtain [gold]Ultimate Strike[/gold] and [gold]Ultimate Defend[/gold].
Requires 100 Gold, 2 removable Strikes, and 2 removable Defends.

Old battle records fall into the bone forge. Basic attacks, basic defenses, obsolete parts—every technique kept merely to survive breaks apart in the sparks.

Ryoma grins.

[red]“How can we surpass ourselves while clinging to the past?”[/red]

Benkei stops the anvil and separates obsolete habits from the instincts that still protect his companions.

Attack becomes an edge. Defense becomes a wall. The two are reforged around one core.

[yellow]“This way, everyone will be safer.”[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.BYRDONIS_NEST: Benkei: [yellow]Push the eggs back. I will hold the nest.[/yellow]
Ryoma: [red]The nest is here. It will come back.[/red]
Add [gold]{Card}[/gold] to your Deck and fight Byrdonis. Hatch it early after winning.
Requires Valor, Fighting Spirit, or Super Spirit.

When the nest splits beneath them, Benkei braces Getter 3 against the broken branches. Ryoma and Hayato climb across the armor and push every rolling egg back into place.

Thorns scrape across his shoulder plating, but Benkei does not yield. Only after the last supporting branch settles does he look up at the sky.

[yellow]“There. Time to go.”[/yellow]

Ryoma bends down, lifts one of the eggs, and sets it straight into the shock cradle inside Getter 1's cockpit. Benkei steadies the hatch while Hayato scans the shadows circling above the nest.

[white]“It will come looking for the egg first. We wait here.”[/white]

[yellow]“It is safe inside. The fight will not reach it.”[/yellow]

Ryoma seals the hatch and looks up at the shadow beyond the cliff.

[red]“Right on time. Plenty of room here. [jitter]CHANGE GETTER ONE![/jitter]”[/red]

Byrdonis crashes into the scree beyond the nest, while leftover [getter_ray]Getter Rays[/getter_ray] still course across the cliff. The egg in the cockpit trembles once, then a hairline crack splits its shell.

Hayato presses one hand to the console and watches the readings jump.

[white]“[getter_ray]Getter Rays[/getter_ray] flooded into it. They accelerated the hatching.”[/white]

Benkei has already cupped a palm beneath the hatch, lowering his voice.

[yellow]“Easy now. It is safe out here.”[/yellow]

The shell breaks apart and a Byrdpip pokes its head out. Ryoma watches it shake the fragments from its wings, then lifts it from the cockpit.

[red]“Looks like it has decided we are family. It is coming with us.”[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.INFESTED_AUTO: Hayato: [white]The parasite and core pulse differently. Cut along this line.[/white]
Lose [red]4[/red] Max HP. Choose 1 card from 2 Powers and 2 zero-cost cards.
Requires more than 4 Max HP and Jammer or Foresight.

Hayato ignores the exposed core. He sends a scan against the aberrant pulse, marking every parasitic filament in his vision.

[white]“You thought this was enough to satisfy Getter 2's pilot?”[/white]

Getter 2 cuts through every mark in an instant. The filaments writhe apart and the machine's core reignites, but a sharp feedback surge tears through the cockpit. Hayato presses a hand to his temple and extracts one complete technique from the restored records.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.THE_LEGENDS_W: Ryoma: [red]A scrap of paper wants to lead me? Tear it up.[/red]
Abandon the treasure map. Obtain [gold]Good Citizen Card[/gold].
You already have Good Citizen Card.
Requires 35 Gold and Getter Claw, Spiral Drill, or Tornado Drill.

Ryoma holds the treasure map to the fire, studies it for two seconds, then tears it apart. A smoke-stained card slips from between its layers. He holds it by one corner.

[red]“A good citizen would never fall for a trick this childish.”[/red]

Hayato reads the card and starts laughing. [white]“You...”[/white]

Benkei leans closer, eyes wide. [yellow]“You actually kept that?”[/yellow]

[red]“Quiet, both of you old men.”[/red]

Hayato crouches before the mural and traces its old fractures. One echo returns half a beat early, revealing the exit.

Getter 2 slips through the narrow passage as stone edges rake sparks from its shell. A refrigerated canister still runs at the end. Coins drop into its calibration slot and the lock springs open.

Hayato studies the green spiral beneath the cap.

[white]“Unexpected profit. We even get a drink.”[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TRIAL.pages.I: Challenge the three elite Knights. Gain buffs at combat start.
Requires Spirit, Drive, Super Spirit, Fighting Spirit, or Persist.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TRIAL.pages.R:
The accused lowers their head, waiting for a sentence written long ago.

Ryoma points at them, his voice drowning out the courtroom: [red]“You are guilty. Guilty of swallowing your anger and letting these fools rule your life.”[/red]

The benches erupt in outrage. Ryoma turns on the jury as the control lever cracks in his grip.

[red]“They may be cowards. You people sitting here to watch are beyond forgiveness.”[/red]

The gavel falls. Chains and shadows surge forward together, and Shin Getter bursts through the stand to meet them.
Challenge the Flail Knight, Spectral Knight, and Magi Knight.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SUNKEN_STATUE: Benkei: [yellow]Water? This is where Getter 3 shines![/yellow]
Lose [red]7[/red] Max HP. Gain more Gold.
Requires more than 7 HP and Persist or Wall.

Getter 3 [jitter]descends[/jitter] along the statue's ruined shoulder. Each layer of pressure tightens around its armor and deepens the warning alarms.

[yellow]“Just a little longer. I have almost found them all.”[/yellow]

Benkei does not stop at the first glint. He shields the recovery bay and searches the bottom until even the last coin buried in silt is aboard, then drags the damaged armor back to the surface.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SPIRALING_WHI: Hayato: [white]Unmake one completed record and reverse-engineer its structure.[/white]
Choose 1 upgraded card to downgrade. Enchant every unenchanted Drill card with [gold]Spiral[/gold].
Requires Tornado Drill or Spiral Drill and at least 1 upgraded card.

Hayato turns Getter 2's drills slowly against the current. The two [sine][aqua]spirals[/aqua][/sine] bite into each other, separating the impossible water pattern into clear [sine][aqua]paths[/aqua][/sine].

A completed battle record unwinds under the reverse calculation and returns to its [u]unupgraded[/u] state. The released structure is not lost. It carves itself into every drill technique, teaching each one to repeat along the same [sine][aqua]path[/aqua][/sine].
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ROUND_TEA_PAR: Ryoma: [red]If the tea is poisoned, say so. If you want a fight, I will give you one![/red]
Take [red]11[/red] unblocked damage. Upgrade 1 Spirit or Fighting Spirit. Obtain a random Relic.
Requires more than 11 HP and an unupgraded Spirit or Fighting Spirit.

Ryoma smells the tea and turns the cup upside down on the table.

[red]“You poisoned the tea and still wear those polite faces. Do you want to fight or not?”[/red]

He flips the round table into the attack. Hayato severs the formation behind it while Benkei stops the chairs crashing toward them. Ryoma takes one blow head-on and tears open an escape with the next.

Hayato finds a relic beneath the wreckage and Benkei passes it over. Ryoma wipes blood from his mouth. [red][jitter]“Now that is hospitality.”[/jitter][/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.RANWID_THE_EL: Ryoma: [red]Want to study Getter? Trade me something from your collection first.[/red]
Remove 1 [gold]Saotome Blueprint[/gold]. Choose 1 of 2 random Relics to obtain.

The old man's feverish stare at Getter reminds Ryoma of Professor Saotome. While they argue, Hayato unfolds one corner of the blueprint. Ranwid's eyes lock onto its combination structure.

[red]“The complete data for one piece from your collection. I choose. Hah, you really do look like that disheveled professor.”[/red]

The elder remains silent for a long moment, then finally agrees to the exchange.
View the 2 Relics offered by Ranwid.
The elder finally lays out two Relics. Ryoma takes one and slides the complete blueprint across. By the time Ranwid looks up, the three are already moving on.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WELCOME_TO_WO: Your abusive purchase in [gold]{Act}[/gold] prevents this transaction.
Customer Credentials: [white]If it remembers the free purchase, make it remember this card too.[/white]
Present the [gold]Good Citizen Card[/gold] and leave normally.
Requires the Good Citizen Card and a previous free shop purchase.

The scanner retrieves the earlier zero-cost transactions. Hayato presses the Good Citizen Card over the warning; after a long pause, the gate lets everyone through.

[white]“It keeps records. So do we.”[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TRASH_HEAP.pa: Benkei: [yellow]Don't dig blindly. I'll hold it up; you find one thing that still works.[/yellow]
Lose [red]12[/red] HP. Choose 1 of 3 relics from the old collection.
Requires more than 12 HP and Indomitable, Iron Wall, or Guts.
The heap collapses, and Benkei makes Getter 3 bear its full weight. Ryoma and Hayato drag three old relics from the gap, but there is time to keep only one.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TINKER_TIME.p: Research Route: [white]The tolerances are wrong. Recalibrate it to Professor Saotome's blueprint.[/white]
Pay [red]50[/red] Gold to reroll the 2 displayed card types.
Requires 50 Gold, a Research or Evolution card, and no prior reroll in this event.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.REFLECTIONS.p: Triple Unity: [red]Don't rush it.[/red] [white]One at a time.[/white] [yellow]I'll hold both sides steady.[/yellow]
Lose [red]5[/red] Max HP. Choose 1 non-Rare, non-Special card to duplicate.
Requires Triple Unity, a valid card to copy, and more than 5 Max HP.
Choose 1 non-Curse, non-Status, non-Rare, non-Special card to duplicate.

Three afterimages settle into one rhythm. The mirror leaves behind a duplicate of a complete combat record.

[red]“There can be another shadow. The seats in the cockpit stay exactly where they are.”[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.DOORS_OF_LIGH: Ryoma: [red]Light, dark—it doesn't matter. Wall, get out of my way![/red]
Lose [red]6[/red] HP. Choose 1 card to Transform into a random Colorless card.
Requires more than 6 HP, a Spirit Drive card, and a Transformable card.
Choose 1 card to Transform into a random Colorless card.

Ryoma punches through the wall between the doors. Light and darkness rewrite the nearest combat record into a colorless outline.

[red][jitter]“Doors are for people who follow rules.”[/jitter][/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WELLSPRING.pa: Getter Ray Route: [red]Let the spring wash the record away. Then let Getter Rays wash the spring away.[/red]
Requires more than 3 Max HP, a Getter Ray card, and a removable card.
[getter_ray]Getter Rays[/getter_ray] strip away an old record, and the spring bites back into the armor. The cleansing remains, along with a permanent wound.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ROOM_FULL_OF_: Benkei: [yellow]Don't eat yet. I'll sort out the pieces that aren't food.[/yellow]
Lose [red]7[/red] HP. Choose 2 of 10 Common cards and Upgrade them.
Requires more than 7 HP and Guts or Indomitable.
Choose 2 safe Common cards to add to your deck.
Benkei samples every piece and sets two safe portions before the others. Ryoma eyes the empty row and laughs: [red]“So that's why Getter 3's pilot got so big.”[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.BUGSLAYER.pag: Benkei: [yellow]Keep arguing about methods. Getter 3 will flatten the swarm in one pass.[/yellow]
Lose [red]5[/red] HP. Upgrade and enchant 1 Getter Rush, then choose 1 Event card.
Requires more than 5 HP and an unupgraded, unenchanted Getter Rush.
Choose 1 Getter Rush to Upgrade and enchant with Spiral.

Getter 3 crushes the swarm flat. Ryoma laughs: [red]“Even Benkei cuts loose like that?”[/red]

Hayato pauses. [white]“Please don't ask me to define ‘cutting loose’ for either of you.”[/white]
Emperor's Fragment: [white]The fragment shows more than one possible trade.[/white]
Pay [red]75[/red] Gold. Choose 1 Relic to give up, then choose 1 of 3 Relics of the same rarity.
Requires 75 Gold, Emperor's Fragment, and a tradable Relic with 3 valid replacements.
Choose a Relic to give to the trader.
View 3 replacement Relics of the same rarity.
Emperor's Fragment reveals three possible futures. Choose one.
Pay 75 Gold and complete the trade.
Choose a different Relic to give up.
The Gold changes hands, and three futures collapse into one Relic. Emperor's Fragment permits a glimpse of the future; it never promised the future for free.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ENDLESS_CONVE: Hayato: [white]Take the maintenance record. Leave the current dish alone.[/white]
Requires 20 Gold, a Strategy card, and no prior use in this event.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.UNREST_SITE.p: Benkei: [yellow]The trees mean no harm. No one here ever truly gets to rest.[/yellow]
Lose [red]5[/red] Max HP. Heal 50% of your missing HP.
Requires missing HP, more than 5 Max HP, and Indomitable, Iron Wall, or Guts.
Benkei plants Getter 3 in the center of the grove and bears the pressure from every side. [yellow]“Close your eyes. I'll hold it for a while.”[/yellow]
Lose [red]4[/red] Max HP. Heal 25% of your missing HP and obtain [gold]Pressure Breathing[/gold].
Requires missing HP, more than 4 Max HP, and a Getter 3 defense card.
Benkei follows Hayato's breathing count through the heaviest impact and saves the method as a combat record. [yellow]“Next time someone has to brace, use this.”[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.LOST_WISP.pag: Benkei: [yellow]Don't let it into anyone's heart. I'll contain it first.[/yellow]
Lose [red]5[/red] Max HP. Obtain [gold]Lost Wisp[/gold] without adding Decay.
Requires more than 5 Max HP and a Getter 3 defense card.
Getter 3 traps the wisp in its palm, leaving a scar that cannot be repaired. [yellow]“The wound stays here. We keep moving together.”[/yellow]
Hayato: [white]Catch it and it brings something back. Know the route, and you know when to leave.[/white]
Requires more than 3 Max HP and a Strategy card.
A silver scan traces the wisp's route. Hayato endures the cold in the circuit and stores the exit coordinates in the deck.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.DROWNING_BEAC: Benkei: [yellow]I'll take the pressure. Split the water with thunder![/yellow]
Lose [red]12[/red] HP. Obtain a Glowwater Potion and Upgrade a random card.
Requires more than 12 HP, a Getter 3 defense card, and an upgradable card.
Thunder divides the murky water into bright layers. The purest glow is bottled while the returning current sears one combat record brighter.
Benkei: [yellow]Fold the beacon's afterglow into the armor.[/yellow]
Requires more than 9 HP and a Getter 3 defense card.
Water pressure pounds the armor until the afterglow settles inside a prism. [yellow]“Can you turn that pressure into fuel?”[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.LUMINOUS_CHOI: Ryoma: [red]I'm sick of that singing. Burn away whatever binds them together![/red]
Requires more than 8 HP, a Getter Ray card, and 2 removable cards.
A narrow Getter Ray cuts across the roots. The choir breaks into scattered notes. [red][jitter]“Much quieter.”[/jitter][/red]
Hayato: [white]Give the choir one silent beat.[/white]
Lose [red]5[/red] HP. Remove 1 card and obtain [gold]Mycelial Silencer[/gold].
Requires more than 5 HP, a Strategy card, and 1 removable card.
Hayato reverses the mycelial rhythm, making the choir miss a beat. He seals the silent fragment in an isolation case.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.COLOSSAL_FLOW: Hayato: [white]The petals close at fixed intervals. Cut in after three seconds.[/white]
Lose [red]2[/red] Max HP. Gain [gold]90[/gold] Gold and leave.
Requires more than 2 Max HP and a Getter 2 speed card.
Getter 2 cuts through the closing petals and carries out a cache of Gold, losing a strip of armor. [white]“This is far enough. Any deeper, and the flower eats the route first.”[/white]
Ryoma: [red]If once isn't enough, hit it again![/red]
Requires more than 6 HP and a Getter 1 charge card.
The first punch opens only a narrow crack. Ryoma wipes the blood from his brow and saves that stubborn momentum as a combat record.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.THE_FUTURE_OF: Pay [red]25[/red] Gold. Choose and consume 1 Potion to obtain [gold]Luminescent Pulse[/gold].
Requires 25 Gold, at least 1 Potion, and a Research or Evolution card or Research Notes.
The original mixture comes apart until only two pulses remain, ready to pass through the whole battlefield. [white]“This is not a shield. Everyone will feel it.”[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ABYSSAL_BATHS: Triple Coordination: [red]Don't bring the whole bath back with us.[/red]
Gain 2 Max HP and heal 2 HP. Obtain [gold]Phase Coolant[/gold].

Bathwater begins seeping into the gaps in the armor. Hayato takes the controls and switches the circuit to the cooling bypass. Ryoma's voice cuts through the rushing water over comms: [red]“Don't bring the whole bath back with us.”[/red]

A bottle of liquid veiled in condensation rises from the surface, while the armor briefly grows within the heat. Hayato contains the backflow and keeps the force of the water from flooding the circuit any further. Only after the gauges return to zero does he store the potion.

[white]“Whether we keep the radiation is our decision now.”[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WATERLOGGED_S: Research Route: [white]The water erased the words, but left the order of evolution behind.[/white]
Requires 75 Gold, the Research condition, and a valid Attack, Skill, or Power.
The last coin falls into the inkwell, and the formula left by the water is transcribed into a combat record.
Research Route: [white]Seal the surfaced evolution formula in a bottle of ink.[/white]
Requires 45 Gold and a Research or Evolution card or Research Notes.
Every legible stroke is copied into a bottle until the liquid settles into deep green. [white]“It works—and it grows back on its own.”[/white]
